content: Mada Rachẹl ore bi, ibhọr igaang-ẹ ọgaangi, ọn-ọkhaama ottem-mamma otzima otzor ọgbaanọkka Lea. Mẹ wọ, on-oben Jekọb bi, “Nang-m va oni mando ode ḿpe-ope.”
Jekọb ọdọkhi ettem ttara Rachẹl, ọbọbh bi, “Kaam wọ nde Ibinọkpaabyi, kw'ọkpọ-ọ bi, aningi va amaan o?”
Rachẹl oben bi, “Ode mando, kkeri Bilha kw'ode ọtzọhmnọng kwaam mẹ. Kọ tzọkh-ẹ ayima abẹ ifha ọmaan va ọnang-m, mbiri nnenga ma ndaak sẹ, nsi echimma chaam.”
Mando kw'ọtzọk ọtzọhmnọng kwẹ Bilha, ọnang Jekọb oyim-ẹ abẹ.
Bilha okwu otzima ibhọr ọmaan nnwa kw'ijinọng ọnang Jekọb.
Rachẹl okpe nnwa nwa Dan, oben bi, “Ibinọkpaabyi okk'aponga paam ọba, obiro ọbhaanga njọhm saam, ọnang-m nnwa kw'ijinọng.”
Iwa Bilha kw'ode ọtzọhmnọng kwa Rachẹl obiro otzima ibhọr, ọmaan nnwa kw'ijinọng kw'ottong afa ọnang Jekọb.
Rachẹl oben bi, “Kaam nkk'ẹfa ndima nsi erima ttara ọgbaanọkka kwaam Lea, mbiri ngem-ẹ.” Mẹ wọ, okpe nnwa nwa Naphtali.
Mada Lea ore bi, ọkk'ọmaan ọkwọbha, ọn-ọtzọkha ọtzọhmnọng kwẹ Zilpa ọnang Jekọb macha kwanọng kwẹ.
Zilpa ọmaan nnwa kw'ijinọng ọnang Jekọb.
Mẹ wọ, Lea oben bi, “Ma wọ ode ojibhaada ọkkakka.” Wa okpe nnwa nwa Gad.
Wa Zilpa kw'ode ọtzọhmnọng kwa Lea, obiro ọmaan nnwa kw'ijinọng kw'ottong afa ọnang Jekọb.
Mẹ wọ e, Lea okpe nnwa nwa Ashẹr, oben bi, “Ettem ẹdaam-m o, da ayokhi-panọng an-ayer-m, idadaama.”
K'ọphagbe kw'awit, Reubẹn oyin k'iwoni otza ore asitzen-kwongi
otzima ochena ọkka kwẹ, Lea. Mẹ wọ, Rachẹl oben Lea bi, “Tzotzokhaan kebh-m akwọngitzọhng bani pa nnwa kwọ, otzim okhuna.”

Yina, Lea ọbọbh Rachẹl bi, “Kw'oyini bi, odim kwaam kw'atzọk kọ kobeng? Kw'bira akwu bi, akwu atzọkha asitzen-kwongi pa nnwa kwaam o?” Rachẹl oben bi, “Ojibhi kẹ, ode mando, kọ tzọkha eyimawu cha mayina, anang-m asitzen-kwongi pa nnwa kwọ otzim okhuna.”

Mada Jekọb okhun eyina k'ẹchọhkha, Lea ọtza okhebh-ẹ, ọgbaakh-ẹ bi, “Mayina on-ode eyimawu chaam e, okhuri bi, kaam nkk'asitzen-kwongi pa nnwa kwaam ndima ndebh chẹ. Mẹ wọ, Jekọb oyima ọmaana Lea m'erungiwu nduma.”
Ibinọkpaabyi ọbhaanga njọhm sa Lea, otzima ibhọr, ọmaan nnwa kw'ijinọng kw'ottong azen ọnang Jekọb.
Lea oben bi, “Ibinọkpaabyi ọkk'aam ochora, okhuri da nnangi odim kwaam ọtzọhmnọng kwaam bi, oyima abẹ.” Wa okpe nnwa nwa Isaaka.
Lea obiro otzima ibhọr ọmaan nnwa kw'ijinọng kw'ottong azadani ọnang Jekọb.
Mẹ wọ, Lea oben bi, “Ibinọkpaabyi ọkk'aam ẹnanga ch'ideden obiro ọnanga, yina kwa kaam nna mbar odim kwaam odik, okhuri bi, nkk'ẹ va p'ijinọng azadani mmaana.” Mẹ wọ, okpe nnwa nwa Zẹbulun.
Ayongi mẹ, Lea obiro ọmaan nnwa kw'ikwanọng, ọkpẹ-ẹ Daina.
Mẹ wọ, Ibinọkpaabyi okwu ojima Rachẹl ọbhaanga njọhm sẹ, okwung-ẹ ẹbhọr.
Rachẹl okwu otzima ibhọr ọmaan nnwa kw'ijinọng, oben bi, “Ibinọkpaabyi ọkk'aam ka mgbar ọrọbha.”
Okpe nnwa nwa Josẹph, oben bi, “Tte Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi obiro ọttar-m nnwa kw'ijinọng ọdọdọk.”
Ọhaabh f'etzirakpo pya Jekọb
K'ogbe kwa Rachẹl okk'Josẹph ọmaana, Jekọb oben Laban bi, “Tte-m ọbọhk mmaana ka man k'obhon.
Kọ nang-m panọng paam ttara va paam pa nkk'ọtzọhm nsa nnang-ọ, ndima mfona. Kọ arong ọtzọhm-dema fa kaam nkk'nsa nnang-ọ kẹ.”
Yina, Laban oben-ẹ bi, “Idikha kaam nkk'ọphyaam ndọkha k'itzitzikha sọ, tzọtzọkhaan kọ kàfona, kkeri kaam nkk'ose mmari, nnonga bi, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ọkk'aam ọda okhuri kọ.”
Laban obiro ọttara bi, “Kọ gbaak-m ekkema ch'ọtzọhm fọ, kkeri kaam ńnang-ọnang.”
Jekọb obhin-ẹ bi, “Kọ arong ọtzọhm fa nkk'nsa nnang-ọ kẹ, abira aronga eden cha nneng nkkeri etzirakpo pyọ, ejibh ẹnang-ọ.

Yina iwa kaam nkwu, wa etzirakpo pyọ kẹhaabhi macha pyẹ ẹn-ẹhaabhi madẹdẹn. Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ọkk'ọ ọda k'ọtzọhm kpenamkpen fa nkk'nsa nnang-ọ. Yina, kọbaan bi abira atte kaam ọbọhk, mbiri nda nnor f'ẹhọhmmọr chaam, ebire etzima eruk akpen o?”

Laban ọbọbh-ẹ bi, “Mbọng f'áror bi, nsi nnang-ọ?” Jekọb on-obhina bi, “Kaam echora manda dani ka mbọhk sọ kinnori. Odik obungikwẹ kwa kaam nnori ode bi, kọ abira atte etzirakpo pyọ ọbọhk, anang-m nkkeri.
Tte nnenga k'ottem kwa arukhimaan-va pọ pa kaam mmi nkkeri, ndekha arukhimaan p'ade akkẹr-ankkẹr, ọmaana avu p'asi attẹttẹr, mach'echora chaam.

Mada ópyiri k'ogbe kwa kọ akwu akkeri etzirakpo pyọ, tte odik ọkkakka kwaam ọkhaama ẹjaakhi bi, idikha kọ are orukhimaan-nwa kpenamkpen kw'oni akkẹr-ankkẹr ode, ọmaana evu kpenamkpen ch'eni attẹttẹr esi k'ottem kwa nden saam, kọ tzọkha bi, mfhu-ofhu.”
Laban oben bi, “Kaam nkk'nkhera k'odik ọkkakka bi, kwẹ ode mach'agbaakhi.”

M'ewu nduma dani, Laban orenga ọrọbha avu-dim p'ade akkẹr-ankkẹr, ọmaana p'asi attẹttẹr, ọmaana avu-gbokha biphyir p'ade akkẹr-ankkẹr, ọmaana p'asi attẹttẹr, ttara arukhimaan-bina biphyir, ọtzọkha ọnang va pẹ bi, bẹ akkeri.
Mẹ wọ, otzima va pẹ obina orenga kw'iwu ittaan, bẹ aji Jekọb kẹ da okkeri etzirakpo mbyonggo pya Laban.
Mando kwa Jekọb ọtzọk achi-bọhnga abhapẹ p'echi cha pọpula ọmaana, abọhnga p'echi ch'almọn, ọmaana p'echi ch'ede bi waaar obori akpakpa, osi bẹ an-awur bi gwaang.
Mẹ wọ, Jekọb ọtzọkha achi-bọhnga p'okk'akpakpa obori, ohok m'agbaakha biphyir p'etzirakpo em-ekwu egwo asi, ttara nttak bi, idikha pyẹ eyim ayok abẹ m'ibe nnuma sa pyẹ em-egwo asi,
pyẹ ekkeri achi-bọhnga mba itzitzikha, pyẹ ẹmaan akkẹr-ankkẹr.

Mẹ wọ, Jekọb ọbhaangi arukhimaan-va ohok ngọmi, yina on-osi mbonggo p'arikhi bi, bẹ akkeri akkẹr-ankkẹr pa Laban itzitzikha. Mẹ wọ, kẹ ọn-ọkhaama etzirakpo pya kẹ ọkhaam, py'oni ka pya Laban dọk attar.

Ogbe kpenamkpen nwa kwa Jekọb ore bi, etzirakpo py'ipanọng py'egwengi for en-eyima ayok abẹ, ọtzọkha achi-bọhnga p'okk'akpakpa obori ohok m'agbaakha k'itzitzikha s'etzirakpo, ifha pyẹ eyima ayok abẹ ẹbaanga mẹ.
Yina, etzirakpo py'eni egwengi, pyẹ achi-bọhnga mbuma kọkpa. Mẹ wọ, mbuma py'egweng-ogwengi en-ede pya kẹ Jekọb. Py'eni egwengi ede pya Laban.
Mando wọ kw'iwa Jekọb otzim okpena ọkkọkkaa kw'okhaam etzirakpo k'ọhaabh, ọmaana atzọhmnọng p'ipanọng ttara p'ijinọng, ọmaana akamẹl ọttara nnyanyaang.

footnotes.text: 30.14 Ositzen-kwongi ode okwongitzọng kw'om-osi kwanọng kw'ọkpaan-ọkpaana otzima ibhọr.
